author: Adobe Creative Cloud
description:
Stop regenerating the same character from scratch. Learn the reference-sheet trick that makes your AI subject recognizable in every pose, angle, and scene.

In this tutorial, you'll discover how to:
- Build multi-angle character reference sheets that keep likeness locked across every new generation
- Merge character sheets and backgrounds into a single prompt to direct pose, lighting, and depth of field
- Isolate and extend full-body assets onto a neutral background for easy cropping, scaling, and reformatting

Perfect for movie posters, character design projects, and campaign concepts.

How do you keep character consistency across your AI-generated projects? Comment below and save this tutorial for your next design.

Contents of this video:
00:01 Intro and meet author Jesús Ramirez
03:48 Generate consistent characters
07:08 Composite references into a cinematic poster
08:05 Prep full-body assets for editable, scalable output
